topic.summary: Four Sensex stocks, including Bharat Electronics, NTPC, Power Grid Corporation and Hindustan Unilever, touched fresh 52-week lows on Friday as the benchmark index declined. The four stocks have fallen between about 6% and 9% over the past month, reflecting continued weakness in their share prices.
topic.title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month
